bio.text: Bobby Pulido is a Democratic candidate for Texas's 15th Congressional District in 2026; on primary night ABC13 projected him as the winner of the Democratic primary over emergency room physician Ada Cuellar.
ABC13 describes him as a Tejano singer and the son of a migrant farm worker, turned Latin Grammy Award-winning artist.
ABC13 reports he will face two-term Republican Rep. Monica De La Cruz in November.

sources.title: Tejano singer Bobby Pulido wins Democratic nomination for U.S. House in Texas' 15th Congressional District - ABC13 Houston
